semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Nissan Tanaka provides specialized welding equipment and gas control systems used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nissan Tanaka manufactures advanced welding equipment and gas control systems tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include the 'Mobile Welder Series' for on-site applications and the 'OrbiMat 180SW' for prefabricated welding tasks, alongside the 'OrbiWeld Series' for precision pipe welding. The company leverages 3D printing technology to enhance their product capabilities.
capabilities: Mobile Welder Series for on-site welding
OrbiWeld Series for precision pipe welding
PPAP back shielding jig with 3D printing technology
